title: Measure rider sag and adjust stock spring preload

applicability.included: Exact standard US2022 YZ450FX original stock suspension.
excluded: Other years, replacement springs/components or aftermarket damping conversions

entry_state: Assembled bike, serviceable stock suspension, exact original adjusters identified.
exit_state: Recorded adjustment and functional checks complete; no internal service performed.
preflight: Stop for leaks, damage, binding or an unidentified adjuster.
Keep the linked diagrams visible to identify distinct controls.
Both spring rings must be accessible on the assembled bike; arrange separate access/refit work if parts must be removed.
critical_stop_conditions: Adjuster at stop before target, inability to identify stock control, or unresolved setup measurement

required_tools.name: Length measuring equipment and appropriate spring-ring/locknut tools

source.document_revision: BEX-2819U-11; ©2022 by Yamaha Motor Corporation, U.S.A.
source.review_note: Exact US source author and independent mechanical review accepted this bounded setup companion. Actual work and measurements remain rider records.

steps.title: Confirm stock spring and serviceability
steps.instruction: Confirm original stock spring and smooth leak-free rear suspension. Clean dirt/mud from locknut and adjusting ring. Record existing installed spring length before loosening anything. This route adjusts the original spring, not a replacement spring or shock.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Measure the unloaded reference
steps.instruction: Support under the engine with rear wheel fully off the ground. Measure distance a between rear axle center and the rear-fender holding bolt shown PDF 362. Record both reference points and the measurement; use them unchanged throughout.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Measure with the rider
steps.instruction: Remove the stand and support the bike upright with a helper. With the rider astride the seat, measure distance b between the same axle center/fender holding bolt. Record rider/equipment for repeatability. Calculate a minus b; Yamaha target is 90–100 mm. If already within range, known actual free/installed measurements establish valid preload, and the locknut is secure, select the already-valid branch to the final record without changing the spring. Otherwise continue with free-length measurement.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

branches.label: Sag and recorded preload are already valid
branches.condition: Rider sag90–100mm and actual known free/installed spring measurements establish preload1.5–18mm with locknut already secure. If free length is unknown, continue measuring instead.

steps.title: Establish the spring reference if adjustment is needed
steps.instruction: Raise rear wheel again. Loosen locknut, then back off adjusting ring until a small clearance exists between ring and spring. Measure actual free spring length as PDF 106 shows. Do not remove the spring or use a guessed catalog length. Keep the spring seated while making the next adjustment.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Set preload within limits
steps.instruction: Turn the ring in diagram direction b to increase preload or c to decrease it. Allowed shortening from measured free length is 1.5–18.0 mm; stock reference is 10.0 mm. One ring turn changes installed length 1.5 mm. Choose a measured setting within those bounds to approach 90–100 mm rider sag, then tighten the locknut as Yamaha directs; this section gives no numeric locknut torque. If rider sag is above 100 mm, increase preload; below 90 mm, decrease preload. Keep the measured preload within its limits.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Recheck with the same rider
steps.instruction: With the rear wheel raised, record a; then remove the stand and record rider-loaded b at the same points and under the same conditions. Repeat adjustment only with rear wheel raised and within the measured preload bounds, securing the locknut each time. If 90–100 mm cannot be achieved within those limits, stop this stock-spring route: source calls for an appropriate optional spring and readjustment, not extra preload beyond the limit.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Record the accepted setup
steps.instruction: Record free/installed spring length, preload amount, unloaded a, rider-loaded b and resulting sag. Verify locknut secure and rear action smooth. Reevaluate after initial break-in because the spring can settle. Spring selection, damping changes and internal shock servicing remain separate. If the already-valid branch was selected, preserve the actual prior free/installed measurements that established preload; do not substitute nominal lengths.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

completeness: Measure rider sag and actual spring preload; adjust the original spring within the OEM limits and record the accepted setup. A valid measured setup can be retained without adjustment.

authoring_template.scope: Structure only; values, controls, sequence and sag datum reviewed in this exact manual.
